title: How much of our power is solar?
description: Solar makes 8.7% of the world's power, and grows more than any other source.

shots.title: Hook: how much is solar?
shots.say: How much of our electricity comes from the Sun? In 2025, about 1 unit in every 11.

shots.title: Still a small slice
shots.say: That is still small. Coal alone made a third of all power, and gas more than a fifth.

shots.title: +30% in one year
shots.say: But solar is the growth story. Its output rose 30% in one year, a record 636 terawatt hours.

shots.title: Three-quarters of new demand
shots.say: Solar alone met three quarters of the rise in world electricity demand.

shots.title: Biggest growth, 4 years running
shots.say: For the fourth year running, solar grew more than any other source.

shots.title: End card
shots.say: A small slice of world power, with the biggest growth.
